title: Council policies by area: section 19, EOTAS and alternative provision
description:
A reference dataset of what the 153 local authorities in England responsible for education publish about education for children who cannot attend school. For each authority it records four entries: the section 19 or medical needs policy, the EOTAS policy or guidance where one is published, what the council publishes about alternative provision, and the free local SEND advice service for the area. It holds 612 entries, one for each of the four kinds for each authority, each with the date it was checked.

It records what each council publishes, as found on the dates shown. It does not describe what any policy says, and nothing in it says whether any council meets its legal duties. Where an entry says "none found", a document could not be found for that column on the council's own site on the date checked; it does not mean the council has no such policy.

Canonical page: https://blog.jameswallace.tech/councils/
